subject: general
question: Which Mughal Emperor was deported to Rangoon by the British?
solution:
__
 
• Bahadur Shah Zafar__ was deported to Rangoon by the British.
 
• Bahadur Shah Zafar was the second son of Akbar II. He was the last Mughal emperor of India.
 
• He reigned for 20 years between 28 September 1837 to 14 September 1857.
 
• He was deported to Burma (presently Myanmar) in the year 1857.
 
• He died on 7 November 1862 due to illness.
